text_block_list.text:
"—The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) had 
finally arrived. Clear blue skies 
stretched over the Yodo turf."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Grandfather, Grandmother. We have 
finally reached this day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Please watch me, watch my run—and the 
moment I seize victory."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Alright... I'm fine now. I believe I can 
do this!
choice_data_list: Go give it everything you've got!
Go and give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Please watch over me as well, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us do our best. Both of us, as 
umamusume of the Mejiro family.
